240-574-5470-6633.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-5470-6633.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

240-1753-5470-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-1753-5470-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

539-1462-3821-4679-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-1462-3821-4679-6797.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Repeat

147-1893-2511.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1893-2511.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2728-6797-6854-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-6797-6854-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-6797-6854-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-1329-3200-7895.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Urza's Bauble.
Cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Little Bear.
When Little Bear enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

1170-1636-4113-7528.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Awaken the Ages using convoke without paying mana.
1170-1636-4113-7528.description:
Cast Awaken the Ages using Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Strife Scholar.
When Strife Scholar enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

4067-5611-7824.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Sliver that does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
4067-5611-7824.description:
Activate a Sliver by tapping it and discarding a card, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the Sliver.
Repeat.

2635-3685-4497.description:
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {7}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, giving Slobad +7/+7 until end of turn and untapping Slobad
When Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding seven {R} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
When Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
2635-3685-4497.notes: If you want to repeat this loop on subsequent turns, you'll need to provide the {7} to start.

3946-4011-7705.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2067-6847.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
When the Pegasi enter, Weftstalker Ardent triggers that many times, dealing that much damage to each opponent.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Patron of the Arts

1409-1652-4365.description:
Activate Patron of the Arts by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Patron of the Arts enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Patron of the Arts.
Resolve the Patron of the Arts trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5402-7010.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5402-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-5078-5402-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

1987-3227-4276-6991.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-3227-4276-6991.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Donnie & April and Scrivener.
When Donnie & April and Scrivener enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3227-4276-6991.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

856-1379-5226-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1640-5016-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Spitemare instead due to Pariah's Shield.
Spitemare triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

132-4306-5090.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color] is at least seven.
132-4306-5090.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {7}.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

643-4338-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Maskwood Nexus, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more +1/+1 counters on it

645-997-2060-3750-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-997-2060-3750-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

1445-2279-4871-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2279-4871-6797.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

856-4231-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar
When Cauldron Familar dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1251-1563-2457-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5968-6290.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You control an additional creature.
4050-5968-6290.description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Lightwheel Enhancements enters the battlefield, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Lightwheel Enhancements attached, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1018-1987-2493-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1018-1987-2493-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Skullwinder.
When Archaeomancer and Skullwinder enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1987-2493-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-851-5742-5743.description:
Activate Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2061-4125-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Warp each turn.
2061-4125-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1675-2034-3490.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1675-2034-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Ob Nixilis' second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ob Nixilis.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

215-353-2440-3263.notablePrerequisites: You have a storm count of at least three.
215-353-2440-3263.description:
Cast Aeve by paying {5}.
Aeve's storm ability triggers, creating a token copy of Aeve for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve the first Aeve spell.
Aeve enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding {C} for each Ooze you control.
Repeat from step 4 for each Aeve spell remaining.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {2}, returning the nontoken Aeve from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2279-3705-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Birgi and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jorn, God of Winter // Kaldring, the Rimestaff

2010-2217-3094.notablePrerequisites:
Jorn does not have summoning sickness.
Snow permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
2010-2217-3094.description:
Cast Thermal Flux by paying {U}, causing Lithoform Engine to become a snow permanent until end of turn.
Move to your combat phase, and declare Jorn as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate all mana producing snow permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Jorn's triggered ability.
Resolve the copy of Jorn's ability, untapping all snow permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.

813-2628-4821.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant and/or sorcery card in hand with cycling.
Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce {3}{U} plus enough additional mana to cycle the instant/sorcery card in hand.
813-2628-4821.description:
Activate all nonland mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U} plus enough mana to pay for the cycling cost of an instant/sorcery card in your hand.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate any instant/sorcery card in your hand's cycling ability by paying its cycling cost and discarding it.
Escape Protocol triggers, causing you to pay {1} to blink Scholar of the Ages.
Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, returning Dramatic Reversal and the card with cycling from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the cycling ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
